title: GPT-4V(ision) as a Generalist Evaluator for Vision-Language Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation and benchmarking of GPT-4V's capabilities as a generalist evaluator for vision-language tasks, such as image-to-text captioning, text-to-image generation, text-guided image editing, and multiple-images to text alignment. It does not include any components or criteria related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
